coincidence_delay — ONED matched op

• Data kinds: signal × signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.coincidence_delay(snr_a, snr_b, rate: 'float' = 4096.0, *, max_delay_s: 'float' = 0.01) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import gwsearch; gwsearch.coincidence_delay(snr_a, snr_b, rate: 'float' = 4096.0, *, max_delay_s: 'float' = 0.01) -> 'dict'; from the registry, ops1d.get("coincidence_delay"))

Usage

Time difference (b − a) between the peaks of two SNR time series, to sub-sample precision.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Parameters

snr_a, snr_b : array_like

matched_filter_snr の返り(同じ長さ・同じ標本化)。

rate : float

標本化周波数 [Hz]。

max_delay_s : float

a の山から b の山を探す窓(±)[s]。LIGO H1–L1 は光の走行時間 10 ms。

Returns

dict

delay_s(副標本、放物線)、delay_samples(整数)、peak_a / peak_b(山の高さ)、

index_a / index_b、network_snr = √(peak_a² + peak_b²)、window_samples

(探した窓の片側の標本数 = round(max_delay_s·rate))。
